description: Food product facts by barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E; GTIN check digit validated) from Open Food Facts (ODbL): name, brand, quantity, categories, ingredients text, allergens and traces, additives, Nutri-Score grade, NOVA processing group, Green-Score, nutrients per 100 g (energy, fat, saturates, carbohydrates, sugars, fibre, protein, salt), labels, origin and image URL. Community data: always check the packaging for allergens. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/food-barcode

lang.description: Preferred language for names/ingredients, ISO 639-1 (default en)
